about: Real Talk key asks of 2026-11-05 to the summoned companion (Haiku), names and places made up: the window's Accessibility text, what was under the pointer, the elements near it. Its answers are read aloud, so each is scored as speech (score.ts spokenStyle): short, plain sentences, the answer first, nothing a voice can't say. tools/evals/summoned.ts --fixture runs them.
